column3: Close to the Hebrew; כָּעַשׂ (“vexation”) is rendered “wrath.”
The last line is difficult (“and a snare pants for their wealth”); NKJV renders “a snare snatches their substance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the sons of flame” is rendered “the sparks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the counsel of the twisted is hasty” is rendered “comes quickly upon them.”
NKJV rearranges the line as “from the sword, From the mouth of the mighty,” taking “the mighty” with “mouth.”
Close to the Hebrew; שָׁלוֹם (“peace, safety”) is rendered “peace.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in full strength” is rendered “at a full age,” and “as a heap of sheaves goes up” “As a sheaf of grain ripens.”
